confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors rely on news reports, crowd-sourced estimates and Eurostat context, not verified July 2026 menus. Beer and coffee are the firmest. Cocktail and wine are proxies from Athens and Corfu listings; cocktail is set near 2x beer and wine near 1.2x beer as the local price relationship. Accommodation is an unsourced model estimate for July peak season. EUR was converted to USD at about 1.12, implied from a third-party AUD/USD and AUD/EUR quote. The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of the RBA overview page, not from the F11.1 CSV.
comparable_city_reasoning: Chania is treated as a Cretan tourist town priced between mainland Greek cities and island resorts. Food anchors use Chania and Crete sources. Drink anchors use Athens and Corfu proxies and Eurostat 2024 alcohol price levels. Accommodation uses general knowledge of mid-sized Greek resort towns in peak season.
